Name: Frames For Objects
Author: FishDay11
Description:
I [b]really like[/b] the idea of Furniture Display Framework! From the moment it came out, I was hoping that someone would make a similar mod. I wanted to keep a collection of skulls beautifully... I didn't wait. And I did it myself!

The mod includes 9 picture frames in which you can insert objects. I tried to align and adjust the size of the objects as universally as possible, but there may not be very beautiful combinations.

To place objects, use the left mouse button on the picture-frame slot. If you want to remove an object from the picture, then use the right mouse button. Identical items are combined, different ones are replaced. when moving the picture, the objects remain in it. I'm not sure what can happen to the items inside if you leave the frame in the chest for a long time... 

[b]Important![/b] Not all items can be framed! The list of impossible includes clothing, weapons and furniture. If you can't insert, then try to fill out the inventory completely and insert something. This way you will find slots faster.

You can buy frames from Robin or the furniture catalog.

If something doesn't work right, let me know. This is my first mod, I'm a little nervous.
